description: Parking Zone is a series of datasets listed in Analyzejerseycity open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Analyzejerseycity. This a map of the streets parking in Zone 10. Coverage: Jersey City, New Jersey. The portal lists 14 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are parking, Zone. The portal shows 10 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-04-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-jerseycitynj-gov-portal.
